name: Imaging
description: Image tools over picked files: inspect, resize, and convert between png, jpeg, gif, webp, and bmp.

operations.name: image.info
operations.description: Probes an image. Input base64; returns {width, height, format}.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked image (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

operations.howto: Inspector pattern: file.pick (kind image) feeds "file"; show width, height, and format from state.

operations.name: image.resize
operations.description: Resizes an image to fit within maxWidth/maxHeight (aspect kept). Returns {base64, width, height, format, size}.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked image (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Output format; omit to keep the source format

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Bind an image element's src to this

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The produced image; chains into file.save

operations.howto: Shrink pattern: file.pick (kind image) feeds "file", number inputs through parseNumber feed maxWidth or maxHeight, and the outputs are a produced image: bind an image element's src to "url" and give file.save the "file" output. The base64 output exists only for legacy file.read chains.

operations.name: image.convert
operations.description: Re-encodes an image as png, jpeg, gif, webp, or bmp. Returns {base64, width, height, format, size}.

inputs.name: file
inputs.description: A picked image (file.pick's file output); preferred over base64

inputs.name: base64
inputs.description: Legacy alternative to "file": base64 from file.read

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: Target: png | jpeg | gif | webp | bmp

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: Bind an image element's src to this

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: The produced image; chains into file.save

operations.howto: Converter pattern: file.pick feeds "file", a select feeds "format" (png, jpeg, gif, webp, bmp), file.save takes the "file" output. The base64 output exists only for legacy file.read chains.
